Players find Dammon in HAV or LOW for the first or second time in the game with Karlach in your party. He will say that he knows a way to upgrade Karlach for the first or second time, depending on how her origin story evolved.
context: Dammon is a former weaponsmith who was pressed into service in Avernus under Zariel and thus recognizes infernal machinery by scent and feel. When Karlach is in the party he immediately detects her infernal engine, warns it isn’t meant to run outside the Hells, and says it’s running dangerously hot. He offers to upgrade or repair the device but says he’ll need infernal iron/metal (and a proper forge) to do the work. The party may already have found a piece of infernal metal Karlach mentioned, or Dammon can point them toward where to look; he also runs a weapons/armor stall when encountered in HAV or LOW.
